newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland Opals to list on Monday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland Opals to list on Monday.

text.p: Queensland Opals NL said it would commence trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on Monday after raising A$2.5 million from a share issue.

The company, which described itself as Australia's first listed opal miner, said it would use the funds to start commercial production from 17 mining and exploration tenements in the Australian state of Queensland.

Initial work would be based on the conversion of two trial mining areas in the Canaway Range, located in the Eromanga region of the state's far west, into full mining operations. The company said it planned to have five mining sites in operation by 1999, along with its own cutting centre located in the opal fields.
